 Appearance :

 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Narendra Kumar Singh
 Mr. Prashant Kumar
 Ms. Kritika Upadhyay
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Anjani Kumar Sharan
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the O.P. No.2 as well as learned APP for the State.
2. Learned counsel for the O.P. No.2 filed a counter-affidavit in the Court.
Let it be placed on record.

3. Petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Khagaria (Mufassil) P.S. Case No.1019 of 2021, registered for the offences under Sections 406, 420, 467, 468, 147 and 120B of the IPC,
pending in the Court of Learned C.J.M. Khagaria.
4. After some arguments, learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission to withdraw this application.
6. Accordingly, this application is dismissed as withdrawn.
